run_visual_shape_array_demo: run the pybullet visual shape array demo that creates instanced duck meshes in a grid
create_visual_shape_array: create a visual shape array with mesh and box geometries for instanced rendering
create_collision_shape_array: create a collision shape array with mesh and box geometries for physics simulation
create_multibody_from_shape_array: create multiple multibody instances that share a single visual and collision shape array
compute_camera_ray_from_mouse: compute a 3D ray from the camera through mouse click coordinates for object picking
